question: 用条码 810000000002 查商品名称以及各仓库库存和安全线。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, p.barcode, w.warehouse_name, b.on_hand_qty, b.safety_stock
FROM retail.products p
JOIN retail.inventory_balances b ON b.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND b.sku = p.sku
JOIN retail.warehouses w ON w.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND w.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND s.store_id = b.store_id
WHERE p.barcode = '810000000002'

question: 目前哪些门店库存低于安全线？还差多少？

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT s.store_name, w.warehouse_name, p.sku, p.product_name,
       b.on_hand_qty, b.safety_stock, b.safety_stock - b.on_hand_qty AS shortage_qty
FROM retail.inventory_balances b
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND p.sku = b.sku
JOIN retail.warehouses w ON w.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND w.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND s.store_id = b.store_id
WHERE b.on_hand_qty < b.safety_stock
ORDER BY shortage_qty DESC, p.sku

question: 按商品汇总试点门店现有库存成本金额，给出金额最高的前五名。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name,
       SUM(b.on_hand_qty) AS on_hand_qty,
       SUM(b.on_hand_qty * p.unit_cost) AS inventory_cost_value
FROM retail.inventory_balances b
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND p.sku = b.sku
WHERE b.store_id = 'STORE-PILOT-001'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY inventory_cost_value DESC
LIMIT 5

question: 有哪些采购申请还在等审批？列出申请人、商品和申请数量。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT r.request_id, r.requested_by, p.sku, p.product_name,
       l.requested_qty, r.created_at AT TIME ZONE s.timezone AS created_at_local
FROM retail.purchase_requests r
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.store_id = r.store_id
JOIN retail.purchase_request_lines l
  ON l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND l.request_id = r.request_id
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND p.sku = l.sku

question: 目前还有哪些未完成采购订单？供应商和预计到货时间是什么？

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT po.po_id, s.supplier_name, po.status,

question: 排除已取消订单后，各供应商有效采购订单金额是多少？

SELECT s.supplier_name,
       SUM(l.ordered_qty * l.unit_cost) AS ordered_amount
FROM retail.purchase_orders po
JOIN retail.suppliers s ON s.tenant_id = po.tenant_id AND s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id

question: 采购订单数量和实际收货、验收数量有哪些差异？请区分拒收与未到货。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT po.po_id, p.sku, p.product_name, l.ordered_qty,
       COALESCE(receipt_totals.received_qty, 0) AS received_qty,
       COALESCE(receipt_totals.accepted_qty, 0) AS accepted_qty,
       COALESCE(receipt_totals.rejected_qty, 0) AS rejected_qty,
       l.ordered_qty - COALESCE(receipt_totals.received_qty, 0) AS not_yet_received_qty
FROM retail.purchase_orders po
JOIN retail.purchase_order_lines l
  ON l.tenant_id = po.tenant_id AND l.po_id = po.po_id
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND p.sku = l.sku
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.tenant_id, r.po_id, rl.po_line_no,
         SUM(rl.received_qty) AS received_qty,
         SUM(rl.accepted_qty) AS accepted_qty,
         SUM(rl.rejected_qty) AS rejected_qty
  FROM retail.receipts r
  JOIN retail.receipt_lines rl
    ON rl.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rl.receipt_id = r.receipt_id
  WHERE r.status IN ('posted', 'partial')
  GROUP BY r.tenant_id, r.po_id, rl.po_line_no
) receipt_totals
  ON receipt_totals.tenant_id = po.tenant_id
 AND receipt_totals.po_id = po.po_id
 AND receipt_totals.po_line_no = l.line_no
WHERE po.status <> 'cancelled'
ORDER BY po.po_id, p.sku

question: 各供应商到货验收合格率是多少？没有收货的供应商也要列出来。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT s.supplier_name,
       COALESCE(supplier_totals.accepted_qty, 0) AS accepted_qty,
       COALESCE(supplier_totals.received_qty, 0) AS received_qty,
       ROUND(100.0 * supplier_totals.accepted_qty / NULLIF(supplier_totals.received_qty, 0), 2) AS acceptance_rate_pct
FROM retail.suppliers s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT po.supplier_id,
         SUM(rl.accepted_qty) AS accepted_qty,
         SUM(rl.received_qty) AS received_qty
  FROM retail.receipts r
  JOIN retail.purchase_orders po ON po.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND po.po_id = r.po_id
  JOIN retail.receipt_lines rl ON rl.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rl.receipt_id = r.receipt_id
  WHERE r.status IN ('posted', 'partial')
  GROUP BY po.supplier_id
) supplier_totals ON supplier_totals.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
ORDER BY s.supplier_name

question: 按收货日期统计实收、合格和拒收数量。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT CAST(r.received_at AT TIME ZONE s.timezone AS DATE) AS receipt_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
       SUM(l.received_qty) AS received_qty,
       SUM(l.accepted_qty) AS accepted_qty,
       SUM(l.rejected_qty) AS rejected_qty
FROM retail.receipts r
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.store_id = r.store_id
JOIN retail.receipt_lines l
  ON l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND l.receipt_id = r.receipt_id
WHERE r.status IN ('posted', 'partial')
GROUP BY CAST(r.received_at AT TIME ZONE s.timezone AS DATE)
ORDER BY receipt_date

question: 现在有哪些调拨单还在途中？每种商品发出了多少，发往哪个仓库？

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT t.transfer_id, p.sku, p.product_name, f.warehouse_name AS from_warehouse,
       d.warehouse_name AS to_warehouse, l.sent_qty
FROM retail.stock_transfers t
JOIN retail.stock_transfer_lines l
  ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND l.transfer_id = t.transfer_id
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND p.sku = l.sku
JOIN retail.warehouses f
  ON f.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND f.warehouse_id = t.from_warehouse_id

  ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND d.warehouse_id = t.to_warehouse_id
WHERE t.status = 'in_transit'

question: 已签收调拨里哪些商品的实收数量少于发出数量？

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT t.transfer_id, p.sku, p.product_name, l.sent_qty, l.received_qty,
       l.sent_qty - l.received_qty AS missing_qty
FROM retail.stock_transfers t
JOIN retail.stock_transfer_lines l
  ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND l.transfer_id = t.transfer_id
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND p.sku = l.sku
WHERE t.status = 'received' AND l.received_qty < l.sent_qty
ORDER BY missing_qty DESC, p.sku

question: 11 月以来各类库存流水分别入库、出库和净变化多少？不含期初库存。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT m.movement_type,
       COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity_delta) FILTER (WHERE m.quantity_delta > 0), 0) AS units_in,
       COALESCE(SUM(-m.quantity_delta) FILTER (WHERE m.quantity_delta < 0), 0) AS units_out,
       SUM(m.quantity_delta) AS net_change
FROM retail.inventory_movements m
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND s.store_id = m.store_id
WHERE m.occurred_at >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE s.timezone)
  AND m.occurred_at < (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE s.timezone)
  AND m.source_type <> 'opening_balance'
GROUP BY m.movement_type
ORDER BY m.movement_type

question: 最近一次已过账盘点有哪些差异？按成本估算差异金额。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT c.count_id, p.sku, p.product_name, l.system_qty, l.counted_qty,
       l.counted_qty - l.system_qty AS quantity_difference,
       (l.counted_qty - l.system_qty) * l.unit_cost AS cost_difference
FROM retail.stock_counts c
JOIN retail.stock_count_lines l
  ON l.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND l.count_id = c.count_id
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND p.sku = l.sku
WHERE c.status = 'posted' AND l.counted_qty <> l.system_qty
ORDER BY c.posted_at DESC, p.sku

question: 按每天列出 11 月 1 日至 18 日的销售净额；取消单排除，退款按退款日扣减。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT events.event_date, SUM(events.amount) AS net_sales_amount
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(s.sold_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone AS DATE) AS event_date,
         SUM(s.total_amount) AS amount
  FROM retail.pos_sales s
  JOIN retail.stores st ON st.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND st.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE s.status = 'completed'
    AND s.sold_at >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)
    AND s.sold_at < (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)
  GROUP BY CAST(s.sold_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone AS DATE)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(r.refunded_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone AS DATE) AS event_date,
         -SUM(l.refund_amount) AS amount
  FROM retail.pos_returns r
  JOIN retail.stores st ON st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND st.store_id = r.store_id
  JOIN retail.pos_return_lines l
    ON l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND l.return_id = r.return_id
  WHERE r.status = 'refunded'
    AND r.refunded_at >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)
    AND r.refunded_at < (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)
  GROUP BY CAST(r.refunded_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone AS DATE)
) events
GROUP BY events.event_date
ORDER BY events.event_date

question: 11 月以来净销售额最高的前五个商品是什么？扣除已完成退款，列净件数和含税净额。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name,
       COALESCE(sales_summary.sold_qty, 0) - COALESCE(refund_summary.refunded_qty, 0) AS net_units,
       COALESCE(sales_summary.gross_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(refund_summary.refund_amount, 0) AS net_sales_amount
FROM retail.products p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT sales_line.sku, SUM(sales_line.quantity) AS sold_qty,
         SUM(sales_line.line_net_amount + sales_line.tax_amount) AS gross_sales_amount
  FROM retail.pos_sales sale_header
  JOIN retail.pos_sale_lines sales_line
    ON sales_line.tenant_id = sale_header.tenant_id AND sales_line.sale_id = sale_header.sale_id
  JOIN retail.stores sales_store
    ON sales_store.tenant_id = sale_header.tenant_id AND sales_store.store_id = sale_header.store_id
  WHERE sale_header.status = 'completed'
    AND sale_header.sold_at >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE sales_store.timezone)
    AND sale_header.sold_at < (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE sales_store.timezone)
  GROUP BY sales_line.sku
) sales_summary ON sales_summary.sku = p.sku
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT return_line.sku, SUM(return_line.return_qty) AS refunded_qty,
         SUM(return_line.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM retail.pos_returns return_header
  JOIN retail.pos_return_lines return_line
    ON return_line.tenant_id = return_header.tenant_id AND return_line.return_id = return_header.return_id
  JOIN retail.stores return_store
    ON return_store.tenant_id = return_header.tenant_id AND return_store.store_id = return_header.store_id
  WHERE return_header.status = 'refunded'
    AND return_header.refunded_at >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE return_store.timezone)
    AND return_header.refunded_at < (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE return_store.timezone)
  GROUP BY return_line.sku
) refund_summary ON refund_summary.sku = p.sku
WHERE COALESCE(sales_summary.sold_qty, 0) > 0
ORDER BY net_sales_amount DESC, net_units DESC
LIMIT 5

question: 11 月已完成退款的商品、退货原因、退货数量和退款额分别是什么？待处理申请不计。

expected.gold_sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, r.reason,
       SUM(l.return_qty) AS refunded_qty,
       SUM(l.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
FROM retail.pos_returns r
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.store_id = r.store_id
JOIN retail.pos_return_lines l
  ON l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND l.return_id = r.return_id
JOIN retail.products p ON p.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND p.sku = l.sku
WHERE r.status = 'refunded'
  AND r.refunded_at >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE s.timezone)
  AND r.refunded_at < (TIMESTAMP '2026-12-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE s.timezone)
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, r.reason
ORDER BY r.reason, p.sku
